p: Boat People at Sicily in the Mediterranean Sea
Lucio Sassi from Parma, Italy - Italia
a: Lampedusa e Linosa (Sicilian: Lampidusa e Linusa) is a comune (municipality) in the Province of Agrigento in the autonomous island region of Sicily in southern Italy. Located about 220 km (137 miles) southwest of Agrigento and about 260 km (162 miles) southeast of Tunis, it is the southernmost municipality of Italy. It includes the islands of Lampedusa, Linosa and Lampione, collectively known as the Pelagian Islands. It has 6,485 inhabitants.

a:
Linosa is one of the Pelagian Islands in the Sicily Channel of the Mediterranean Sea.
The island is a part of the Italian comune of Lampedusa e Linosa, part of the province of Agrigento in Sicily, Italy. It has a population of 430.
